title: Terilogy Holdings Corporation autorise un programme de rachat d’actions.
Terilogy Holdings Corporation authorizes a Buyback Plan.
Terilogy Holdings Corporation announces an Equity Buyback for 580,000 shares, representing 3.48% for ¥200 million.
Terilogy Holdings Corporation (Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) : 5133) annonce un rachat d’actions portant sur 580 000 actions, soit 3,48 %, pour 200 millions de yens.
